title: Sky ship with glowing sails snags a London chimney with its anchor
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Sky ship with glowing sails snags a London chimney with its anchor, about 1700s-1800s at London, UK, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I read a story of a a sailing ship with glowing sails flying over London and an anchor comes out and snags a chimney and breaks the top off of a chimney.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he has had many UFO encounters, says he once read an old story set in London in the early 1800s. According to that story, a sailing ship with glowing sails flew over the city, dropped an anchor that caught on a chimney, and broke the top off. He tells it as an example of strange flying craft being reported long before modern aircraft.
